name: TCRBreastCLASSOFTREATCodeSystem
title: 台灣癌症登記 治療分類（本院／他院）（CLASSOFTREAT）
description: Taiwan Cancer Registry code table for CLASSOFTREAT (治療分類（本院／他院）). 碼冊出處：Longform p.83-88 治療狀態分類 (#2.3.2). Generated from tcr_decoder; every code round-trips through decode/encode (tests/test_codebook_conformance.py).

concept.display: 未於申報醫院接受任何治療即死亡。
concept.definition: 未於申報醫院接受任何治療即死亡。 / Died at the reporting hospital without receiving any treatment there (diagnosed here and died or discharged critically ill, or diagnosed elsewhere and transferred here before dying)

designation.value: Died at the reporting hospital without receiving any treatment there (diagnosed here and died or discharged critically ill, or diagnosed elsewhere and transferred here before dying)

concept.display: 僅於申報醫院接受首次療程，未於他院接受任何首次療程。
concept.definition: 僅於申報醫院接受首次療程，未於他院接受任何首次療程。 / The entire first course of therapy was given at the reporting hospital, with none at another hospital (includes a case whose only first-course therapy is one of the registry's defined "other treatments")

designation.value: The entire first course of therapy was given at the reporting hospital, with none at another hospital (includes a case whose only first-course therapy is one of the registry's defined "other treatments")

concept.display: 未於申報醫院接受任何首次療程（僅於他院接受，或主要治療計畫由他院規劃）。
concept.definition: 未於申報醫院接受任何首次療程（僅於他院接受，或主要治療計畫由他院規劃）。 / No first-course therapy at the reporting hospital: the whole first course was given elsewhere, or the case came for a second opinion with no treatment here, or the main treatment plan was set by another hospital (e.g. maintenance therapy continued here, or a referred-out partial radiotherapy course)

designation.value: No first-course therapy at the reporting hospital: the whole first course was given elsewhere, or the case came for a second opinion with no treatment here, or the main treatment plan was set by another hospital (e.g. maintenance therapy continued here, or a referred-out partial radiotherapy course)

concept.display: 於申報醫院接受部分首次療程，也於他院接受部分首次療程。
concept.definition: 於申報醫院接受部分首次療程，也於他院接受部分首次療程。 / Part of the first course of therapy at the reporting hospital, part at another hospital

designation.value: Part of the first course of therapy at the reporting hospital, part at another hospital

concept.display: 首次療程為不予治療或再密切觀察，或僅給予非腫瘤切除之緩和性手術/疼痛控制/支持療法。
concept.definition: 首次療程為不予治療或再密切觀察，或僅給予非腫瘤切除之緩和性手術/疼痛控制/支持療法。 / The first course of therapy was watchful observation, or only non-tumour-directed palliative surgery, pain control, supportive care, or a hospice referral

designation.value: The first course of therapy was watchful observation, or only non-tumour-directed palliative surgery, pain control, supportive care, or a hospice referral

concept.display: 首次療程僅有另類治療。
concept.definition: 首次療程僅有另類治療。 / The first course of therapy was alternative therapy only

designation.value: The first course of therapy was alternative therapy only

concept.display: 首次療程為個案拒絕治療。
concept.definition: 首次療程為個案拒絕治療。 / The patient refused treatment in the first course

designation.value: The patient refused treatment in the first course

concept.display: 他院診斷及治療，因癌症或其治療的併發症至申報醫院求診。
concept.definition: 他院診斷及治療，因癌症或其治療的併發症至申報醫院求診。 / Diagnosed and treated elsewhere; presented at the reporting hospital because of a complication of the cancer or its treatment

designation.value: Diagnosed and treated elsewhere; presented at the reporting hospital because of a complication of the cancer or its treatment

concept.display: 他院診斷個案，為了其他疾病至申報醫院求診（不需申報）。
concept.definition: 他院診斷個案，為了其他疾病至申報醫院求診（不需申報）。 / Diagnosed elsewhere; presented at the reporting hospital for an unrelated condition -- not reportable

designation.value: Diagnosed elsewhere; presented at the reporting hospital for an unrelated condition -- not reportable

concept.display: 首次療程不詳，也無法確認個案拒絕治療。
concept.definition: 首次療程不詳，也無法確認個案拒絕治療。 / First-course treatment status unknown, and refusal cannot be confirmed either (e.g. lost to follow-up after the initial diagnosis at the reporting hospital)

designation.value: First-course treatment status unknown, and refusal cannot be confirmed either (e.g. lost to follow-up after the initial diagnosis at the reporting hospital)
